reply_text:
It renders cleanly: the Voxterm screenshot sits in the margin beside the two opening paragraphs, with the caption just above the gap-bars chart, and nothing overlaps. I'll commit locally.I've added the Voxterm screenshot to the homepage margin with your caption and committed it locally as `05200f2`. It isn't live yet because I haven't pushed.

**What's in the commit:**
- **Image:** I cropped your phone's status bar and the browser address bar off the top, so the image starts at "voxterm". I also removed the half-hidden last line under the gesture bar at the bottom. It's saved as `img/voxterm.jpg`, 540 px wide and 82 KB.
- **Position:** it's a margin note on the "I thought I was getting really good at agentic coding… I built my own system for automating agents" paragraph, which is the sentence the picture illustrates. The caption is *"Me running agents like a boss."*, in italics like the site's other captions. The alt text describes the screen for screen readers and for any text-only visitor like the Zai runs.
- **Checked at laptop width:** I rendered it locally. It sits beside the first two paragraphs, below the Minard chart, and ends just above the gap bars, with nothing overlapping.

**Worth knowing:**
- **On a phone it's hidden** behind a ⊕ toggle, like every margin note on the site. So the phone skimmer, kimi-2, would still see the Minard chart as the only thing to tap. If you want Voxterm to be what phone visitors see first, it would have to be a figure in the main column rather than a margin note.
- **The screenshot shows real session details:** seat names, model names (`claude-opus-5-5`, `gpt-5.6-sol`, `k3`) and a fragment of one of my bash commands. None of it is sensitive, but it is public detail about your setup.

**Pushing to `origin` (hel.git on the Linode) is what makes it live.** Should I push? The public turn feed from earlier is also still waiting on your decision, and kimi-1 (strategist) and kimi-3 (CTO) are still running.
